Briar.combo: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on Briar's engage path or escape path first. Use Taliyah W Seismic Shove to push Briar onto the rock field and stun her, then hit her with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley during the stun. If Briar is charging Briar E Chilling Scream, use Taliyah W Seismic Shove to interrupt it.
Briar.watch: Keep your distance to avoid Briar Q Head Rush, which dashes in, stuns Taliyah, and reduces her resistances. Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth in advance on the path Briar takes when diving in with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, so the dash triggers a stun. When Briar starts charging Briar E Chilling Scream, interrupt it with Taliyah W Seismic Shove, and do not stand with your back to a wall in case she releases a fully charged scream. Stand behind your frontline because Briar R Certain Death's bloodstone marks the first champion it hits.
Briar.fight: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on Briar's charge path, and fire Taliyah Q Threaded Volley when she is stunned or has little chance to change direction. If Briar charges Briar E Chilling Scream, interrupt it with the knockup from Taliyah W Seismic Shove to prevent the heal and wall stun. Just taking some of Briar's health can delay her next jungle route, so do not overcommit to chasing her down.
Briar.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first because Briar deals mostly physical damage and Taliyah has low armor. If Briar's healing makes duels last too long, fit Morellonomicon in after one core item.
Briar.escape: Do not go in just because Briar Q Head Rush is down; also check Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and Briar R Certain Death. The opening comes especially before Briar R Certain Death is back up. At that point, use Taliyah R Weaver's Wall to reposition or Taliyah E Unraveled Earth to block her path before taking damage, then catch Briar with Taliyah W Seismic Shove.
Briar.laning: Push the lane and secure vision to prepare for Briar's early ganks, and avoid standing for long in the middle of a lane section without vision. Taliyah can farm camps quickly to scale, then look for counterganks where Briar's jungle route is predictable.
Briar.phase: In the late game, Taliyah has very low health and armor, so fight from the back to avoid allowing Briar to engage.
Briar.teamfight: Stand behind your frontline so they take the engage from Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and the first hit of Briar R Certain Death. Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on the engage path in advance, and use Taliyah W Seismic Shove on Briar's path to push her away if she tries to reach your ranged carry. In narrow objective areas, use Taliyah R Weaver's Wall to split the formations or block the entrance.

Jax.laning: Your allied minions can give Jax Q Leap Strike a springboard, so keep your distance instead of standing with the minion wave.
Jax.combo: Lay Taliyah E Unraveled Earth first, then push Jax onto the rock field with Taliyah W Seismic Shove. Hit him with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley while he’s stunned. You can also try to stun him by laying Taliyah E Unraveled Earth in advance along the path he’ll take with Jax Q Leap Strike.
Jax.escape: The moment you bait out Jax Q Leap Strike is your chance to engage. If Jax E Counter Strike is also down, close the distance with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and catch him with Taliyah W Seismic Shove. If you want to move using Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall, use it before taking damage and before the fight begins.
Jax.fight: Trade briefly and create distance before Jax builds attack speed with P Relentless Assault. Look for a chance to attack after Jax E Counter Strike is down, but if he has just used Jax Q Leap Strike, block his path with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and catch him with Taliyah W Seismic Shove.
Jax.phase: Taliyah is strongest in the mid game as her ability power items stack up, while in the late game even letting Jax engage once is dangerous.
Jax.teamfight: Lay Taliyah E Unraveled Earth across Jax Q Leap Strike’s entry path, then push Jax away from your team with Taliyah W Seismic Shove if he comes in. Don’t group up where you could all be caught by Jax E Counter Strike’s area stun. Use Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall to split Jax from the enemy back line or block their escape route.
Jax.watch: Jax Q Leap Strike can use a minion or ward as a springboard to close the distance, so don’t stand next to one. When Jax E Counter Strike is active, stop basic attacking and move out of its area stun range. It’s a good idea to lay Taliyah E Unraveled Earth along his approach path in advance to stun him when he comes in with Jax Q Leap Strike.

Amumu.escape: The opening comes after Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy are down. Amumu has no ability to create distance on his own, so place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and catch him with Taliyah W Seismic Shove. If you plan to close the distance with Taliyah R Weaver's Wall, use it before taking damage.
Amumu.teamfight: While Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is available, avoid grouping with allies and keep your distance in open terrain. Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on Amumu's engage path, and push him away with Taliyah W Seismic Shove when he comes in. After Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is down, use Taliyah R Weaver's Wall to split the enemy team or block their escape path.
Amumu.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance against Amumu's damage, but also watch out for getting caught by Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy.
Amumu.combo: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on Amumu's escape path first, then use Taliyah W Seismic Shove to push him onto it. Hit him with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley while he is stunned crossing the rock field. Taliyah Q Threaded Volley fires in a fixed direction, so use it when Amumu has little chance to change direction.
Amumu.fight: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on Amumu's approach path in advance to stop his engage, and use Taliyah W Seismic Shove to push him away if he tries to get close. Fight while adjusting your distance after Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is down. If Amumu has no way to escape, place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and use Taliyah W Seismic Shove to push him onto it.
Amumu.laning: Near the lane, keep a minion between you and Amumu and move unpredictably to dodge Amumu Q Bandage Toss.
Amumu.phase: Mid game, while your ability power items are coming together, is Taliyah's strongest period. In the late game, even one engage can be dangerous, so fight from the back.
Amumu.watch: Amumu Q Bandage Toss stops at the first target it hits, so avoid it with a minion or jungle monster between you and Amumu. Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy stuns surrounding units in an area, so keep your distance before Amumu gets close and avoid grouping with allies. Amumu W Despair continuously deals damage based on maximum health, with greater damage the closer you are, so do not stay close for long.

Brand.phase: Look actively for openings in mid game as your ability power items come together, but fight from the back in the late game to avoid allowing an engage.
Brand.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Prioritize magic resistance because Brand deals mostly magic damage.
Brand.combo: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on Brand's escape path first, then use Taliyah W Seismic Shove to push him onto it. Hit him with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley while he is stunned crossing the rock field. If you aim Taliyah W Seismic Shove in the wrong direction, you will only displace Brand, so decide where you want him to land first.
Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility ability, so engage as soon as Brand W Pillar of Flame is down. Brand Q Sear only stuns targets that are ablaze, so if you are burning, dodge the projectile before closing the distance. If you plan to engage with Taliyah R Weaver's Wall, use it before taking damage.
Brand.fight: Take the opportunity right after Brand W Pillar of Flame is down. Set up your engage path with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth, and if you can use it before the fight, close the distance with Taliyah R Weaver's Wall. Trading repeatedly after being hit by Brand's poke lets Brand P Blaze stack, so dodge his first ability before fighting.
Brand.laning: Do not last hit next to a burning minion, since Brand E Conflagration can spread from it.
Brand.teamfight: Spread out from allies to reduce Brand E Conflagration spreading and Brand R Pyroclasm bouncing. Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on the engage path and push incoming enemies away with Taliyah W Seismic Shove. Use Taliyah R Weaver's Wall to split the enemy frontline from the backline or block their escape path.
Brand.watch: Dodge Brand's first ability to prevent Brand P Blaze from stacking. If you are ablaze, Brand Q Sear can stun you, so move out of its projectile path or hide behind a minion. In teamfights, spread out from allies to avoid Brand E Conflagration spreading and Brand R Pyroclasm bouncing.

Belveth.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first because Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom deal mostly physical damage. To counter the healing from Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet, fit Morellonomicon in after one core item.
Belveth.combo: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on Bel'Veth's escape path or dash path first. Then use Taliyah W Seismic Shove to push her onto the rock field and stun her, and hit her with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley while she cannot move. Using Taliyah W Seismic Shove first will not lead into the rock field stun.
Belveth.escape: Dodge Bel'Veth W Above and Below; the opening comes right after Bel'Veth Q Void Surge is down. Bel'Veth Q Void Surge has a separate cooldown for each direction, so note the axis she just dashed along, place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth, then catch her with Taliyah W Seismic Shove. If only one Bel'Veth Q Void Surge charge is down, she can escape with another movement ability if you go in immediately.
Belveth.fight: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on Bel'Veth Q Void Surge's path in advance to stop her dash. Do not unload damage while Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom is spinning; interrupt it with the knockup from Taliyah W Seismic Shove or attack after it ends. If you dodge Bel'Veth W Above and Below to the side, you can use Taliyah W Seismic Shove to push her away and create distance.
Belveth.laning: Look for opportunities to take large monsters and camps before Bel'Veth builds up stacks.
Belveth.phase: Bel'Veth's stacks build permanently and make her stronger over time, while even one engage can be dangerous for Taliyah in the late game, so keep your distance.
Belveth.teamfight: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on the engage path to stop Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, and push Bel'Veth away with Taliyah W Seismic Shove if she tries to reach an ally. At narrow objective entrances, use Taliyah R Weaver's Wall to block Bel'Veth's engage path or split the enemy team. If an ally dies and Void Coral appears, retreat before Bel'Veth can pick it up, and delay the teamfight while she is transformed.
Belveth.watch: Bel'Veth W Above and Below slows and knocks you up, and also resets Bel'Veth Q Void Surge's cooldown, so sidestep when she closes in. Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom greatly reduces her incoming damage while it spins, so use Taliyah Q Threaded Volley after it ends. Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet provides healing and deals true damage based on missing health, so be especially careful when health is low.

RekSai.watch: Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow knocks Taliyah airborne, so when Rek'Sai burrows, avoid narrow paths and move toward open ground. Right after Rek'Sai damages you, also watch out for Rek'Sai R Void Rush and stay close to your allies.
RekSai.build: Rek'Sai deals mostly physical damage, so use Cloth Armor to survive the early game and build armor first. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. To counter the healing from Rek'Sai P Fury of the Xer'Sai, fit Morellonomicon in after one core item.
RekSai.combo: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth first on Rek'Sai's approach or escape route. Then push Rek'Sai onto the rock field with Taliyah W Seismic Shove to stun her, and hit her with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley while she is immobilized.
RekSai.escape: Dodging the knock-up from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow gives Taliyah a chance to counterattack. Even if Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel is down, she can still escape if Rek'Sai R Void Rush is available, so pin her down with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and Taliyah W Seismic Shove, especially before that ultimate comes back up.
RekSai.fight: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth in advance along the path Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel would take to block her dash. If you dodge the knock-up from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, push her away with Taliyah W Seismic Shove and attack while keeping your distance.
RekSai.laning: Don't push the lane recklessly or walk alone through areas without vision in the early game. If you spot a Rek'Sai tunnel entrance, walk over it to destroy it. Taliyah should clear camps quickly to scale instead of forcing early ganks, and look for counterganks when Rek'Sai's pathing is clear.
RekSai.phase: In the early game, watch for Rek'Sai's ganks, avoid giving up a kill, and focus on scaling. Late game, even allowing one engage from Rek'Sai is dangerous, so stay in the back line and keep your distance.
RekSai.teamfight: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth in the approach path to block Rek'Sai's dash, and knock her away with Taliyah W Seismic Shove if she approaches your ranged carry. In narrow objective areas, use Taliyah R Weaver's Wall to split the enemy team or block the entrance.

Vi.combo: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth in Vi's escape route first, then use Taliyah W Seismic Shove to push her onto it. If Vi is stunned after crossing the minefield, hit her with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley. If you use Taliyah W Seismic Shove first, you'll only push Vi without a minefield to stop Vi Q Vault Breaker.
Vi.build: Vi’s main damage is physical and Taliyah has low armor, so start with Cloth Armor to withstand it. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots and prioritize armor.
Vi.escape: The moment after you dodge or make Vi use Q Vault Breaker is your chance to engage while her mobility is down. At that point, close the gap with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth or, if you can use it before taking damage, R Weaver’s Wall, then land W Seismic Shove. Save your push while Vi is using R Cease and Desist and use it after she lands.
Vi.fight: If Vi engages with P Blast Shield active, trade briefly after the shield is removed. Vi W Denting Blows puts you at a disadvantage if you’re hit repeatedly, so create distance again. Right after Vi uses Q Vault Breaker, block her path with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and push her into it with Taliyah W Seismic Shove.
Vi.laning: Clear camps quickly to scale, and look for counterganks where you can track Vi’s path. Right after Vi uses a skill on minions, she can engage with P Blast Shield active, so trade after the shield is removed.
Vi.phase: The mid game, when you have ability power items, is Taliyah’s strongest point. In the late game, even allowing Vi to engage once is dangerous, so keep your distance in the back line.
Vi.teamfight: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on Vi’s approach in advance, then use Taliyah W Seismic Shove to push her away from your damage dealers after she engages. If Vi R Cease and Desist is available, don’t go into fog of war alone; stay within range of your allies’ protective abilities. In narrow objective terrain, block her approach with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and split the side of the enemy team with Vi using Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall.
Vi.watch: Vi Q Vault Breaker deals heavy damage when fully charged, so move back or to the side to dodge when you see her charging. While Vi is charging at you with R Cease and Desist, don’t try to push her away with Taliyah W Seismic Shove; use it after Vi lands and the knock-up ends.

Ekko.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Prioritize magic resistance because Ekko deals mostly magic damage. Fit Morellonomicon in after one core item to counter the healing from Ekko R Chronobreak.
Ekko.combo: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on Ekko's engage path first. The stun triggers if Ekko dashes onto Taliyah E Unraveled Earth or if you push him across it with Taliyah W Seismic Shove. Hit him with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley during the stun.
Ekko.escape: Right after Ekko uses Ekko E Phase Dive is your chance to catch him with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and Taliyah W Seismic Shove. It is safer to start the main fight after Ekko R Chronobreak is also down. If you plan to use Taliyah R Weaver's Wall to reposition, use it before taking damage and before the fight starts.
Ekko.fight: Right after Ekko uses Ekko E Phase Dive to close the distance, his mobility ability is down, so place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and use Taliyah W Seismic Shove to push him onto it and stun him. Follow up with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley. If Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, do not chase deep solely because health is low.
Ekko.laning: Move clear of the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder and the marked area of Ekko W Parallel Convergence.
Ekko.phase: In the late game, even one engage can be dangerous, so stay back and stop Ekko from getting close.
Ekko.teamfight: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on the engage path to stop Ekko E Phase Dive's dash, and push Ekko away with Taliyah W Seismic Shove when he comes in. Right after Ekko uses Ekko E Phase Dive to close the distance, look to catch him with the crowd control from Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and Taliyah W Seismic Shove. Use Taliyah R Weaver's Wall to split the enemy team or block their escape path.
Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave the marked area to avoid the stun and shield. Also sidestep the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder. If Ekko's afterimage appears behind him, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, so do not overchase even if health is low.

Elise.build: Use Null-Magic Mantle to survive the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first because Elise deals mostly magic damage and Taliyah has low magic resistance. To counter the healing from Elise P Spider Queen, fit Morellonomicon in after completing one core item.
Elise.combo: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth first, then use Taliyah W Seismic Shove to push Elise onto it. Follow with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley while Elise is stunned crossing the rock field. Taliyah Q Threaded Volley fires in a fixed direction, so use it during the stun when Elise has little chance to change direction.
Elise.escape: The opening to close the distance comes right after you make Elise use Elise Q Venomous Bite. Especially once you confirm Elise E Cocoon and Elise E Rappel are also down, block her path with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and catch her with Taliyah W Seismic Shove. If Elise uses Elise E Rappel to go airborne, place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth in advance where she will land.
Elise.fight: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on Elise Q Venomous Bite's path to stop her dash. If Elise E Cocoon and Elise E Rappel are both down, use Taliyah W Seismic Shove to push Elise onto the rock field, then hit her with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley while she is stunned.
Elise.laning: Secure ample vision in the early game, and do not push the lane recklessly when Elise is not visible. Taliyah can grow by clearing early camps quickly, then look for counterganks where Elise's route is predictable. In lane, stand behind minions to dodge Elise E Cocoon.
Elise.phase: Fight actively in mid game as your ability power items come together, but stay back and keep your distance in the late game to avoid allowing an engage.
Elise.teamfight: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on the engage path to limit the route Elise Q Venomous Bite can take, and push Elise away with Taliyah W Seismic Shove when she comes in. Use Taliyah R Weaver's Wall to split the enemy frontline from the backline or block their escape path. In front of Dragon or Baron, place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth at a narrow entrance and block the path with Taliyah R Weaver's Wall.
Elise.watch: At full health, be especially wary of Elise Q Neurotoxin; after health has decreased, be especially wary of her finishing engage when she transforms with Elise R Spider Form. Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth in advance on Elise's approach path.

Evelynn.build: Evelynn deals mostly magic damage and Taliyah has relatively low magic resistance, so buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads. To counter the healing from Evelynn P Demon Shade, fit Morellonomicon in after completing one core item. Evelynn W Allure reduces magic resistance, so retreating before the mark matures takes priority even if you have built resistance.
Evelynn.combo: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on Evelynn's engage path first, then use Taliyah W Seismic Shove to push her onto the rock field. Fire Taliyah Q Threaded Volley while she is stunned. If you use Taliyah W Seismic Shove first, you will only displace her without immobilizing her, so follow the correct order.
Evelynn.escape: If Evelynn has only used her mobility ability, Evelynn E Whiplash, she can still escape with Evelynn R Last Caress, so do not chase immediately. Look for an opportunity before Evelynn R Last Caress comes back up; limit her escape path with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth, then push her onto it with Taliyah W Seismic Shove to catch her. If you plan to reposition with Taliyah R Weaver's Wall, use it before taking damage and before the fight starts.
Evelynn.fight: If the mark from Evelynn W Allure appears on you, place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on her expected engage path and retreat rather than trading damage. Evelynn E Whiplash's dash stuns her if she crosses the rock field, so use Taliyah W Seismic Shove to push her onto it then and hit her with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley.
Evelynn.laning: Carry a Control Ward, and place vision by the camp where Evelynn may start a fight.
Evelynn.phase: In the late game, even one engage from Evelynn can be dangerous for Taliyah, so keep your distance within your allies' vision.
Evelynn.teamfight: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth in advance on the path Evelynn would take to reach your backline carries, and push her away with Taliyah W Seismic Shove if she engages. Use Taliyah R Weaver's Wall to split the enemy team or block their escape path, and break it immediately if it blocks your allies' chase. In narrow terrain around Dragon or Baron, block the engage path with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and check whether you can use Taliyah R Weaver's Wall before the fight.
Evelynn.watch: If the mark from Evelynn W Allure appears on you, she is already nearby and preparing her charm, so retreat before the mark matures and alert your allies. Evelynn E Whiplash after the charm deals damage based on your max health, and Evelynn R Last Caress is especially dangerous when your health is low.

Fiddlesticks.build: Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads. Fiddlesticks deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. To counter the healing from Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest, slot Morellonomicon in after one core item.
Fiddlesticks.combo: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth along Fiddlesticks’ escape route first, then push him onto it with Taliyah W Seismic Shove. Hit him with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley while he’s stunned as he crosses the rock field. If he’s already fleeing, aim Taliyah W Seismic Shove toward your team.
Fiddlesticks.escape: If Fiddlesticks Q Terrify and the silence from Fiddlesticks E Reap are down, you’re less likely to be locked down when you engage. Block his escape route with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth, then push him with Taliyah W Seismic Shove to keep him from getting out.
Fiddlesticks.fight: Save Taliyah W Seismic Shove to interrupt Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest while he channels it. If you can’t interrupt Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm, get out of range before fighting. Cast Taliyah Q Threaded Volley when Fiddlesticks can’t change his direction.
Fiddlesticks.laning: Farm camps quickly and scale with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley, then look for counterganks where you can track Fiddlesticks’ route. Keep vision in the brushes behind lanes during gank windows.
Fiddlesticks.phase: In the late game, allowing even one engage is dangerous, so stay back and keep your distance.
Fiddlesticks.teamfight: Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest, Fiddlesticks E Reap, and Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm all hit an area, so spread out from your team and don’t enter narrow passages without vision as a group. Lay Taliyah E Unraveled Earth across the entry route and use Taliyah W Seismic Shove to push back Fiddlesticks as he comes in. Before fighting over an objective, secure vision in the brushes and entry routes, then split the enemy team with Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall.
Fiddlesticks.watch: Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm enters after channeling, so interrupt it with Taliyah W Seismic Shove as soon as you see the cast. If you can’t interrupt it, move out of range and wait out its duration. If Fiddlesticks has been out of sight for a long time, watch for brush ambushes, and don’t pass by an unchecked Scarecrow Effigy.

Gragas.build: Gragas deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury’s Treads. If Gragas P Happy Hour’s healing becomes a problem, slot Morellonomicon in after one core item.
Gragas.combo: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth first, then push Gragas onto it with Taliyah W Seismic Shove. If he’s stunned as he crosses the rock field, follow up with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley.
Gragas.escape: The moment Gragas E Body Slam is down is your chance to engage. Block his escape route with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and push him onto it with Taliyah W Seismic Shove. If you want to approach with Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall, use it before taking damage and before the fight begins.
Gragas.fight: Gragas takes reduced damage while drinking with W Drunken Rage, so briefly hold off on your burst. Bait out Gragas E Body Slam, then block his path with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and push him onto the rock field with Taliyah W Seismic Shove. Cast Taliyah Q Threaded Volley while he’s stunned.
Gragas.laning: Don’t stay where Gragas Q Barrel Roll has been placed.
Gragas.phase: Gragas’s sustained damage falls off in the late game, but letting him engage on Taliyah once is still dangerous, so keep your distance.
Gragas.teamfight: Don’t leave your back line alone within range of Gragas E Body Slam, and lay Taliyah E Unraveled Earth across his entry route in advance. If Gragas engages, push him back with Taliyah W Seismic Shove. If Gragas E Body Slam hits you, first get outside the barrel’s radius. Use Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall to split the enemy team or block their escape route.
Gragas.watch: When you see Gragas Q Barrel Roll, leave its radius before it explodes. If Gragas E Body Slam hits you near the barrel, you’re likely to get hit by the follow-up explosion too, so lay Taliyah E Unraveled Earth across his entry route in advance. When Gragas has R Explosive Cask available, don’t stand with an enemy turret or the enemy team behind you.

Graves.build: Graves deals mostly physical damage, and Taliyah has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Get through the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps.
Graves.combo: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth along Graves’ escape route first. Push him onto the rock field with Taliyah W Seismic Shove to stun him, then hit him with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley. Aim Taliyah W Seismic Shove to cut off his escape route.
Graves.escape: If only Graves E Quickdraw is down, he can still escape with Graves R Collateral Damage, so don’t rush your engage. Your chance comes before Graves R Collateral Damage is back, especially after he’s used both mobility tools. Block his path with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and lock him down with Taliyah W Seismic Shove. If Graves W Smoke Screen is still available, secure vision from outside the smoke before fighting.
Graves.fight: Trade back or create distance while Graves reloads after firing two shots. Lay Taliyah E Unraveled Earth along his approach path in advance to stop Graves E Quickdraw, then cast Taliyah Q Threaded Volley when he’s immobilized. Fight with a unit between you and him to block his basic attacks.
Graves.laning: In the jungle, farm camps quickly instead of forcing early ganks, and look for counterganks where you can track the enemy’s route.
Graves.phase: Once you’ve built up ability power items in the mid game, actively look for fights, but pressure Graves from the early game onward so he has no time to stack. In the late game, even letting him engage on Taliyah once is dangerous, so keep your distance in the back line.
Graves.teamfight: Lay Taliyah E Unraveled Earth across the entry route to block Graves E Quickdraw, then push him back with Taliyah W Seismic Shove if he comes in. Use Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall to split the enemy team or block their escape route. At narrow objective terrain, control the entrance with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth, but watch out for Graves Q End of the Line, which explodes immediately when it hits a wall.
Graves.watch: Graves Q End of the Line explodes immediately when it hits terrain, so avoid fighting with a wall behind you. If you’re caught in Graves W Smoke Screen, take the shortest route out to regain vision and movement speed. Graves E Quickdraw and Graves R Collateral Damage are both mobility tools, so don’t chase recklessly when only one is down.

Hecarim.build: Hecarim Q Rampage and Hecarim E Devastating Charge deal mostly physical damage, so get through the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps. To counter the healing from Hecarim W Spirit of Dread, slot Morellonomicon in after completing one core item.
Hecarim.combo: Lay Taliyah E Unraveled Earth along Hecarim’s entry path first, then push him across it with Taliyah W Seismic Shove. Cast Taliyah Q Threaded Volley while he’s stunned to make it easier to hit him with the shards, whose direction is fixed.
Hecarim.escape: If only Hecarim E Devastating Charge is down, Hecarim can escape with R Onslaught of Shadows, so don’t engage too hastily. Look for a chance before Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows is back; block his path with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and catch him with Taliyah W Seismic Shove.
Hecarim.fight: When a fight starts, slow Hecarim first with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley or Taliyah E Unraveled Earth to reduce both his approach and his damage.
Hecarim.phase: In the late game, even letting Hecarim engage on Taliyah once is dangerous, so keep your distance in the back line.
Hecarim.teamfight: Spread out from your team so multiple people aren’t caught by Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows, and lay Taliyah E Unraveled Earth across his entry route in advance. Place Taliyah W Seismic Shove along the path Hecarim takes to reach your team’s ranged carry to push him back. Use Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall to split Hecarim’s team or block their escape route.
Hecarim.watch: The farther Hecarim runs with E Devastating Charge, the more damage and knockback it deals. When he turns and starts running, move close to your team and lay Taliyah E Unraveled Earth across his entry route. Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows can fear multiple people, so spread out during teamfights.

Ivern.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury’s Treads. Ivern deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance, and watch for allies following up on the root from Ivern Q Rootcaller and the knock-up from Ivern R Daisy!.
Ivern.combo: If Ivern Q Rootcaller is down, place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth along the enemy’s escape route first. Then push them onto the rock field with Taliyah W Seismic Shove to stun them, and hit them with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley while they’re stunned.
Ivern.escape: The moment you bait out Ivern Q Rootcaller is your window to close the distance. At that moment, block the entry route with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and push the enemy onto the rock field with Taliyah W Seismic Shove. If you want to join up using Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall, use it before taking damage and before the fight begins.
Ivern.fight: Close the distance just after Ivern Q Rootcaller is down, and target whoever is affected by Ivern E Triggerseed after the shield bursts. Taliyah Q Threaded Volley travels in a fixed direction, so cast it when Taliyah W Seismic Shove makes it hard for the enemy to move. If Ivern R Daisy! is blocking the way, don’t cast Taliyah Q Threaded Volley at an enemy behind her.
Ivern.laning: If you secure vision in Ivern’s jungle early, you can track his route to harvest the camps where he planted seeds and look for counterganks. When moving around, hug walls to use the movement speed from Taliyah P Rock Surfing.
Ivern.phase: Taliyah is strongest in the mid game as her ability power items stack up; in the late game, stay behind your team so you don’t let enemies engage on you.
Ivern.teamfight: Lay Taliyah E Unraveled Earth across the entry route to punish enemies coming in via Ivern Q Rootcaller, and push back any who get in with Taliyah W Seismic Shove. Use Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall to split the enemy front and back lines or block their escape route. Focus down an ally Ivern shields first instead of chasing Ivern deep.
Ivern.watch: If Ivern Q Rootcaller hits you, Ivern’s allies will dash in, so stand behind minions or terrain before he throws it. If Ivern R Daisy! starts attacking you, reposition to avoid the knock-up after three consecutive attacks. Watch for ambushes beside brushes that suddenly appear from Ivern W Brushmaker.

JarvanIV.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps.
JarvanIV.escape: Then close the distance with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall, and follow up with Taliyah W Seismic Shove.
JarvanIV.fight: If you’ve weathered that attack, that’s a reasonable window to trade before its bonus damage applies to the same target again.
JarvanIV.teamfight: On narrow terrain around Dragon or Baron, use Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall to split the enemy team or block the entrance.
JarvanIV.watch: Jarvan IV can throw his flag and dash over thin walls, so when he disappears from sight, watch the entry route beyond the wall as well.

Karthus.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury’s Treads. Karthus deals mostly magic damage, and Taliyah has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Karthus.combo: First, place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth along Karthus’s escape route. Then push him onto the rock field with Taliyah W Seismic Shove to stun him, and cast Taliyah Q Threaded Volley while he’s stunned. If Karthus is already fleeing, aim Taliyah W Seismic Shove toward your team.
Karthus.escape: If Karthus W Wall of Pain has been placed, choose a route around it instead of walking through it. If you want to approach with Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall, use it before taking damage and before the fight begins.
Karthus.fight: Karthus can’t create distance on his own, so approach along a route that avoids Karthus W Wall of Pain. Block his path with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and push him onto the rock field with Taliyah W Seismic Shove, then hit him with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley while he’s stunned. Taliyah Q Threaded Volley travels in a fixed direction, so cast it when Karthus has difficulty changing direction.
Karthus.laning: Dodge the warning area for Karthus Q Lay Waste, and use a position overlapping with minions so you aren’t hit alone.
Karthus.phase: In the late game, even letting an enemy engage on Taliyah once is dangerous, so fight while keeping your distance.
Karthus.teamfight: Lay Taliyah E Unraveled Earth across the entry route and push back enemies who come in with Taliyah W Seismic Shove. Use Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall to split the enemy team or block their escape route, but break the wall immediately if it blocks your team’s chase. Even after killing Karthus, don’t stay near his corpse; reposition, and clear the front line before entering the range of Karthus E Defile.
Karthus.watch: Karthus Q Lay Waste deals increased damage if it hits you alone, so walk out of its blast radius and use minions or allies to overlap your position with theirs. Karthus W Wall of Pain reduces your magic resistance and slows you when you cross it, so go around the wall and quickly leave the range of Karthus E Defile as well. After killing Karthus, move straight away from his corpse to avoid the abilities he casts with Karthus P Death Defied, and keep enough health to survive Karthus R Requiem.

LeeSin.build: Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Lee Sin's main damage is physical, and Taliyah has low armor, so build armor first.
LeeSin.combo: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth first on Lee Sin's entry path or escape route. Then use Taliyah W Seismic Shove to push him across the rock field and stun him, and hit him with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley during the stun. Taliyah Q Threaded Volley's firing direction is fixed, so use it during the stun, when Lee Sin can't change his movement direction.
LeeSin.escape: The window before Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike comes back is your chance to go in. If only Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will is down, wait and account for his remaining mobility; catch him with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and Taliyah W Seismic Shove once his mobility abilities are down.
LeeSin.fight: Avoid dueling Lee Sin early and grow by clearing camps quickly. If Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike misses or is down, block his entry path with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and look for a fight. Focus your damage right after Lee Sin uses W Safeguard / Iron Will to enter.
LeeSin.laning: Early on, focus on clearing camps and growing rather than forcing ganks, and look for a countergank where you can read Lee Sin's pathing.
LeeSin.phase: Lee Sin is strong in early duels, so Taliyah should back off and grow. Lee Sin falls off late, but Taliyah is still in danger if she lets him engage once, so keep your distance.
LeeSin.teamfight: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on the entry path to stop Lee Sin's dash, and use Taliyah W Seismic Shove to push him away from allies if he gets in. Keep some space between allies to prepare for Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage, and don't stand directly behind a high-health ally. Use Taliyah R Weaver's Wall to split the enemy team or block an escape route.
LeeSin.watch: Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will can target a ward to cross a wall, so stay away from walls where you have no vision.

MasterYi.build: Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first against Master Yi's main physical damage, but prepare for the true damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style with your total health. If healing from Master Yi W Meditate is a problem, fit Morellonomicon in after one core item.
MasterYi.combo: Once Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends and he lands, place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth first. Then use Taliyah W Seismic Shove to push him across the rock field and stun him, and hit him with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley during the stun. If Master Yi activates W Meditate, interrupt it with the airborne from Taliyah W Seismic Shove.
MasterYi.escape: The window to go in is right after you make Master Yi use his movement ability, Q Alpha Strike. Block his entry path with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth, or close the gap with Taliyah R Weaver's Wall before taking damage, then use Taliyah W Seismic Shove. You can't use Taliyah R Weaver's Wall if you recently took damage from a champion or structure, so account for that before the fight.
MasterYi.fight: After you make Master Yi use Q Alpha Strike, you have a chance to close the gap and fight. Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth, then use Taliyah W Seismic Shove to push him across it and stun him, and hit him with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley while he can't change his movement direction. Don't rely on slows to create distance while Master Yi R Highlander is active.
MasterYi.laning: Use Taliyah Q Threaded Volley to clear camps quickly, and look for a countergank where you can read Master Yi's jungle pathing.
MasterYi.phase: Master Yi is weak in the jungle early, so Taliyah should take the chance to grow and secure early objectives to slow his growth. Taliyah is strongest in the mid game as she builds ability power items, so get actively involved then. In the late game, Master Yi becomes stronger and Taliyah is in danger if she lets him engage once, so stay behind and keep your distance.
MasterYi.teamfight: Pre-place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on the entry path to stop Master Yi from approaching, and use Taliyah W Seismic Shove to push him away if he gets in. If Master Yi uses W Meditate, interrupt it with the airborne from Taliyah W Seismic Shove, and prevent him from moving on to another target after killing an isolated ally. Use Taliyah R Weaver's Wall to split the enemy team or block an escape route.
MasterYi.watch: You can't target Master Yi while he is casting Q Alpha Strike, so use your abilities right after he lands. When Master Yi R Highlander is active, the slow from Taliyah Q Threaded Volley has no effect, so use the airborne from Taliyah W Seismic Shove to create distance. Be careful not to let Master Yi get on top of you, since armor can't reduce the true damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style.

MonkeyKing.build: Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Wukong's damage is mostly physical, and Taliyah has relatively low armor, so build armor first. To counter healing from Wukong P Stone Skin, fit Morellonomicon in after buying one core item.
MonkeyKing.combo: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth first on Wukong's escape route, then use Taliyah W Seismic Shove to push him across it. Fire Taliyah Q Threaded Volley as soon as he is stunned. Make sure you're not mistaking Wukong W Warrior Trickster's stationary clone for the real one before using your combo.
MonkeyKing.escape: Look for a chance to go in after Wukong W Warrior Trickster is used and before it comes back. Check whether Wukong E Nimbus Strike is also down to reduce the chance of him escaping with his remaining mobility. Then close the gap with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and Taliyah R Weaver's Wall, and catch him with Taliyah W Seismic Shove.
MonkeyKing.fight: Wukong has low magic resistance, so Taliyah's magic damage is effective, but if you stay in an extended fight, Wukong P Stone Skin's armor and healing build up. Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on Wukong's approach path, trade briefly, then create distance. Before Wukong W Warrior Trickster comes back, look for a chance to push the real Wukong across the rock field with Taliyah W Seismic Shove.
MonkeyKing.laning: Once Wukong E Nimbus Strike gets onto you, the rest of the trade becomes unfavorable, so manage your distance from outside its range first.
MonkeyKing.phase: In the late game, Taliyah is in danger if she lets Wukong engage once, so stay behind and keep your distance.
MonkeyKing.teamfight: While Wukong R Cyclone is ready, don't group too closely with allies, and pre-place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on the entry path. Use Taliyah W Seismic Shove on Wukong's path toward your allies to push him away. Use Taliyah R Weaver's Wall to split the enemy team or block an escape route, and look for a fight or objective right after Wukong R Cyclone is down.
MonkeyKing.watch: You can't dodge targeted Wukong E Nimbus Strike, so stay outside its range. When Wukong W Warrior Trickster creates a clone, don't waste abilities on the stationary clone; watch which direction the real Wukong is heading.

Nidalee.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Nidalee's damage is mostly magic, so build magic resistance first. To counter healing from Nidalee E Primal Surge, fit Morellonomicon in after completing one core item.
Nidalee.combo: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth first, then use W Seismic Shove to push Nidalee across the rock field. If she is stunned while crossing it, follow up with Q Threaded Volley. When responding to Nidalee W Pounce, pre-place E on her entry path.
Nidalee.escape: The moment after you make Nidalee use W Pounce is your chance to close the gap and go in. You can approach with Taliyah R Weaver's Wall before the fight, then place E Unraveled Earth on Nidalee's escape route and use W Seismic Shove to push her across it and catch her. Taliyah R Weaver's Wall can't be used if you've taken damage recently, so don't count on it as an escape after you're in danger.
Nidalee.fight: Dodge Nidalee Q Javelin Toss and W Bushwhack so you can start the fight without a hunt mark. Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on Nidalee W Pounce's entry path, then use W Seismic Shove to push her across it and hit her with Q Threaded Volley while she's stunned. Right after Nidalee uses W Pounce, she has no mobility spell to escape, so it's your chance to close the gap and catch her.
Nidalee.laning: Watch for Nidalee W Bushwhack around the river and jungle entrances; check with a Control Ward or an area-of-effect ability before entering. Look for a countergank where you can read Nidalee's pathing.
Nidalee.phase: In the late game, even one engage is dangerous, so stay behind and keep your distance.
Nidalee.teamfight: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on the entry path to block Nidalee W Pounce, and use W Seismic Shove to push her away if she gets in. Remember where Nidalee came out to throw her spear, and look for a chance to catch her after she uses Pounce. Use Taliyah R Weaver's Wall to split the enemy team or block an escape route, and control the path with E at narrow objective entrances.
Nidalee.watch: Nidalee Q Javelin Toss hurts more the farther it travels, so prioritize dodging spears from a distant Nidalee and keep minions or your allied frontline between you. You also need to dodge Nidalee W Bushwhack to avoid getting marked for the hunt. If you are marked, save Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and Taliyah W Seismic Shove for when Nidalee uses W Pounce to enter.

Nocturne.build: Nocturne’s main damage is physical and Taliyah has low armor, so start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps. If healing from Nocturne P Umbra Blades is a problem, fit Morellonomicon into your build after completing one core item.
Nocturne.combo: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth first, then push Nocturne onto the rock field with Taliyah W Seismic Shove to stun him, and hit him with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley. If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active, break the shield with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley first, then apply crowd control in this order.
Nocturne.escape: While Nocturne R Paranoia is down, he has no way to engage, so it’s an opportunity to close the gap with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and R Weaver’s Wall. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror is also down, push him onto the rock field with Taliyah W Seismic Shove. If you use Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall for movement, cast it before taking damage and before the fight starts.
Nocturne.fight: Look to engage when Nocturne R Paranoia is unavailable. If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is still available, first break the spell shield with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley, then lock him down with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and W Seismic Shove and hit him with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror is tethered to you, create distance first to break the fear.
Nocturne.laning: Clear camps quickly with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley on fresh ground, and look for counterganks where you can track Nocturne’s path. Keep vision on the river and jungle entrances so you have a place to retreat before Nocturne R Paranoia is activated.
Nocturne.phase: In the late game, Taliyah’s health and armor are very low, so position in the back line to avoid allowing Nocturne to engage.
Nocturne.teamfight: When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens the screen, don’t scatter; move toward your allies. Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on the approach in advance to stop Nocturne’s dash, and use Taliyah W Seismic Shove on his incoming path to push him away. Use Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall to split the enemy team or block an escape route, and destroy it immediately if it blocks your allies’ chase.
Nocturne.watch: When the screen darkens from Nocturne R Paranoia, don’t get caught alone; move toward your allies immediately. If Nocturne Q Duskbringer hits you, he can chase quickly along its trail, so don’t run straight away; angle toward your allies or a turret. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror tethers you, create distance to break it before the fear triggers.

Nunu.build: Nunu & Willump deal mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first and use a Null-Magic Mantle to survive the early game. Choose Mercury's Treads for both magic resistance and tenacity. To counter the healing from Nunu & Willump Q Consume, complete one core item, then fit in Morellonomicon.
Nunu.combo: Fire Taliyah Q Threaded Volley during that stun. When ganking, place the rock field along their escape route. If they are already fleeing, aim Taliyah W Seismic Shove toward your allies.
Nunu.escape: Taliyah can engage after the crowd control from Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! and Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage is down. Nunu & Willump has no ability to create distance, so block the way with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and catch them with Taliyah W Seismic Shove. If you haven't taken damage before the fight, you can also close the gap first with Taliyah R Weaver's Wall.
Nunu.fight: Once Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! is down, keep your distance and block their approach with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth. If Nunu & Willump tries to avoid the rock field, push them onto it with Taliyah W Seismic Shove, then hit them with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley while they are stunned. Nunu & Willump can heal with Q Consume, so apply Grievous Wounds to set up a finishing opportunity.
Nunu.laning: They may return via the Scuttle Crab after ganking once, so keep track of routes outside your vision.
Nunu.phase: Even allowing one engage is dangerous late game, so fight from the back and keep your distance.
Nunu.teamfight: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth in advance on Nunu & Willump's approach path, then knock them back with Taliyah W Seismic Shove when they approach. Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero is a channel, so interrupt it with the knock-up from Taliyah W Seismic Shove to prevent its explosion damage. Use Taliyah R Weaver's Wall to split the enemy team or block their escape routes. At narrow objective entrances, control the approach with it together with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth.
Nunu.watch: Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! knocks you up from long range. When you see it coming, move toward the direction the snowball came from instead of running straight away, and move into the area Nunu & Willump already passed through. If Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage hits you, move out immediately before the root triggers.

Poppy.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Poppy's main damage is physical, and Taliyah has low armor, so build armor first.
Poppy.combo: When Poppy E Heroic Charge is down, first place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on Poppy's escape route. Then push her onto the rock field with Taliyah W Seismic Shove to stun her, and fire Taliyah Q Threaded Volley while she has trouble moving.
Poppy.escape: Engage right after forcing Poppy to use E Heroic Charge. To move with Taliyah R Weaver's Wall, use it before taking damage, before the fight starts.
Poppy.fight: Right after Poppy E Heroic Charge is used up is your chance to close the gap and fight. Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on the escape route, push Poppy onto it with Taliyah W Seismic Shove to stun her, then hit her with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley. Even as Poppy's health decreases, her armor and magic resistance increase, so engage only when you can finish her reliably.
Poppy.laning: Avoid standing with your back to walls or narrow passages to dodge the stun from Poppy E Heroic Charge. When the shield thrown by Poppy P Iron Ambassador lands, step on it first to deny her the shield.
Poppy.phase: Your health and armor are very low late game, so stay behind the team to avoid allowing Poppy to engage.
Poppy.teamfight: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth in the approach path to block Poppy E Heroic Charge. Set up Taliyah W Seismic Shove along the route Poppy would take to reach your ranged carry, and knock her away. Use Taliyah R Weaver's Wall to split the enemy team or block their escape route; break it immediately if it blocks your allies' pursuit.
Poppy.watch: Poppy E Heroic Charge stuns you if it hits a wall, so stand in open space without your back to a wall. If Poppy Q Hammer Shock hits you with its first strike, immediately leave the area before the follow-up blast. If Poppy spins her hammer to charge R Keeper's Verdict, move sideways out of its path.

Rammus.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Rammus's main damage is magic, and Taliyah has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Rammus.combo: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth first, then push Rammus onto it with Taliyah W Seismic Shove. Hit him with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley while he is stunned as he crosses the rock field. Also place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth in advance along Rammus R Soaring Slam's approach path.
Rammus.escape: If Rammus E Frenzying Taunt is also down, watch its range and use Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and Taliyah W Seismic Shove to stop his engage. If Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, don't focus your damage until it ends.
Rammus.fight: When Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, back off and focus your damage right after it ends. While Rammus R Soaring Slam is down, close the gap with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and Taliyah R Weaver's Wall, then push him onto the rock field with Taliyah W Seismic Shove. Use Taliyah Q Threaded Volley when he has trouble changing direction.
Rammus.laning: Clear camps quickly to scale in the jungle, and look for counterganks where you can read Rammus's pathing.
Rammus.phase: Even allowing one engage is dangerous late game, so keep Rammus at a distance and fight from range.
Rammus.teamfight: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on Rammus's approach path, then knock him back with Taliyah W Seismic Shove when he approaches. Dodge widely from Rammus R Soaring Slam after Rammus Q Powerball, and stay away from the landing point. Use Taliyah R Weaver's Wall to split the enemy team or block their escape route. When blocking a narrow objective entrance, also watch your allies' pursuit.
Rammus.watch: Put minions between you and Rammus Q Powerball before he rolls in. Rammus R Soaring Slam has a large area when used after Rammus Q Powerball builds speed, so move well away and immediately leave the aftershock zone at the landing point. Stay out of Rammus E Frenzying Taunt range.

Rengar.build: Rengar's main damage is physical, and Taliyah has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. If the healing from Rengar W Battle Roar is a problem, fit Morellonomicon in after one core item.
Rengar.combo: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth first, then push Rengar onto the rock field with Taliyah W Seismic Shove.
Rengar.escape: Dodge Rengar E Bola Strike and engage when Rengar W Battle Roar is down. Rengar has no ability to create distance, so close the gap with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and Taliyah R Weaver's Wall, then catch him with Taliyah W Seismic Shove.
Rengar.fight: Trade when Rengar's resource bar is empty. After confirming that Rengar W Battle Roar has been used, catch him with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and Taliyah W Seismic Shove, then focus your damage. You can also counter Rengar's dash by placing Taliyah E Unraveled Earth in advance along his approach path.
Rengar.laning: Clear camps quickly with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley on fresh ground to scale, and look for counterganks where you can read Rengar's pathing. Avoid paths beside brushes when Rengar is unseen.
Rengar.phase: Even allowing one engage is dangerous late game, so stay in the back line where Rengar can't catch you.
Rengar.teamfight: Stand behind your frontline and within your team's vision, arranging your formation so Rengar approaching with Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt is revealed first. Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth in the approach path, and set up Taliyah W Seismic Shove along Rengar's route to knock him away. Use Taliyah R Weaver's Wall to split the enemy team or block their escape route; break it immediately if it blocks your allies' pursuit.
Rengar.watch: Rengar P Unseen Predator's leap from a brush lets him engage and build Ferocity at the same time, so avoid passing beside brushes when Rengar is unseen and use a Control Ward for vision. When Rengar's resource bar is full, Rengar E Bola Strike can root you and empowered Rengar W Battle Roar can remove crowd control, so avoid trading. Don't roam alone while injured, in case Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt is active.

Sejuani.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Sejuani's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Sejuani W Winter's Wrath deals physical damage and isn't blocked by magic resistance.
Sejuani.combo: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth first, then push Sejuani onto the rock field with Taliyah W Seismic Shove. Hit her with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley while she is stunned as she crosses the rock field. If you use Taliyah W Seismic Shove first, you only push Sejuani away without pinning her down.
Sejuani.escape: Engage right after Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down. Close the gap with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth or Taliyah R Weaver's Wall, then catch her with Taliyah W Seismic Shove. Taliyah R Weaver's Wall cannot be used if you've recently taken damage from a champion or structure, so use it before taking damage when you need it for movement.
Sejuani.fight: The moment Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down is your chance to close the gap and fight. Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth in the approach path so Sejuani is stunned if she dashes in, then push her onto it with Taliyah W Seismic Shove. If Sejuani's Frost Armor is active, damage her first to remove her slow immunity.
Sejuani.laning: Clear camps quickly with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley on fresh ground to scale instead of forcing early ganks. Look for counterganks where you can read Sejuani's pathing.
Sejuani.phase: Sejuani's kill and damage stats are low in the early game, so Taliyah should clear camps quickly to scale and look for jungle control and objectives. Taliyah is very weak late game, so keep your distance and don't allow Sejuani to engage.
Sejuani.teamfight: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth in advance in the approach path to block Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, then knock Sejuani away with Taliyah W Seismic Shove if she gets in. Use Taliyah R Weaver's Wall to split the enemy frontline from the back line or block their escape route. In dragon or Baron fights, place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth at a narrow entrance and block the path with Taliyah R Weaver's Wall.
Sejuani.watch: Sejuani Q Arctic Assault dashes in and knocks you up, and Sejuani R Glacial Prison stuns, so dodge sideways when you see the tell. If Sejuani W Winter's Wrath's first hit lands, get out of range before its second hit deals heavy damage and slows you. Sejuani E Permafrost stacks from basic attacks by melee allies too, so move away immediately when its indicator starts filling.

Shaco.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first against the damage from Shaco W Jack In The Box, Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison, and Shaco R Hallucinate. Shaco Q Deceive deals physical damage, which magic resistance doesn't block, so build health too.
Shaco.combo: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth first along Shaco's movement path, then push him across it with Taliyah W Seismic Shove. Hit him with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley while he is stunned.
Shaco.escape: Shaco is vulnerable to being caught just after appearing with Q Deceive, when you have a chance to close the gap. Check the approach path with vision first if you suspect Shaco W Jack In The Box is there.
Shaco.fight: Right after Shaco appears with Q Deceive, he can't immediately escape with the same ability, so focus your damage with your allies. Fire Taliyah Q Threaded Volley while he is immobilized.
Shaco.laning: Keep vision at your jungle entrances, clear camps quickly to scale, then look for counterganks where you can read Shaco's pathing. Assume brushes without vision contain Shaco W Jack In The Box and check before entering.
Shaco.phase: Shaco is weaker in isolated fights late game, but allowing one engage is still dangerous for Taliyah, so fight from the back.
Shaco.teamfight: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth in the approach path and knock Shaco away with Taliyah W Seismic Shove if he engages on your allies. Right after Shaco appears with Q Deceive, focus your damage on the real Shaco with your allies, and move away from where the Shaco R Hallucinate clone dies. Use Taliyah R Weaver's Wall to split the enemy team or block their escape route.
Shaco.watch: Watch out for the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box in brushes without vision and around objectives. If Shaco Q Deceive gets behind you, his empowered basic attack and Shaco P Backstab are dangerous, so stand with your back to a wall or face your allies if you think Shaco is nearby. Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison deals more damage when health is low, so don't pass through areas without vision after a fight.

Shyvana.build: Shyvana deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Use Null-Magic Mantle to survive the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If the healing from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis is a problem, fit Morellonomicon in after one core item.
Shyvana.combo: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth first on Shyvana's escape route. Then push her onto the rock field with Taliyah W Seismic Shove to stun her, and hit her with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley while she has trouble changing direction. If Shyvana is engaging with R Dragon's Descent, catch her in this order after she lands.
Shyvana.escape: Look for an opening to engage when Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is down or her Fury bar is empty. Shyvana has no way to create distance, so approach with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and Taliyah R Weaver's Wall, then catch her with Taliyah W Seismic Shove.
Shyvana.fight: Shyvana's strength comes from fighting up close, so keep your distance and slow her with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley. If Shyvana engages with R Dragon's Descent, place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth after she lands and use Taliyah W Seismic Shove to push her across it. Pressure her when her Fury bar is empty or when Dragon Form ends and she returns to human form.
Shyvana.laning: Clear camps quickly to scale, and look for counterganks where you can read Shyvana's pathing. Take Shyvana's camps and objectives first in the early game to slow how quickly Shyvana P Scalemail stacks.
Shyvana.phase: Shyvana has few Shyvana P Scalemail stacks early, so pressure her over camps and objectives. Shyvana's permanent stacks build over time, and Taliyah is vulnerable to engages late game, so make the most of your early advantage.
Shyvana.teamfight: Spread out so Shyvana R Dragon's Descent and Shyvana E Molten Burst don't hit multiple allies. Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth in the approach path, and knock away Shyvana after she lands with Taliyah W Seismic Shove. In narrow objective areas, use Taliyah R Weaver's Wall to block the entrance or escape route and split Shyvana off from your allies.
Shyvana.watch: Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is unstoppable during its dash, so Taliyah W Seismic Shove can't interrupt it. Dodge its path, then catch Shyvana with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and Taliyah W Seismic Shove after she lands. Keep your distance and watch out for the slow and max-health-based damage from Shyvana E Molten Burst, and the melee damage from Shyvana Q Emberstrike.

Skarner.build: Decide early whether to build Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar to counter Skarner R Impale’s suppression. Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots, prioritizing magic resistance against Skarner P Threads of Vibration, W Seismic Bastion, and R Impale. Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and E Ixtal’s Impact deal physical damage, so don’t rely on magic resistance alone when facing him.
Skarner.combo: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth first on Skarner’s approach or escape route. Then push Skarner onto the rock field with W Seismic Shove to stun him, and hit him with Q Threaded Volley while he is immobilized. Aim W Seismic Shove to push Skarner onto the rock field.
Skarner.escape: The moment after you make Skarner use E Ixtal’s Impact is your opening to go in. Close the gap with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and R Weaver’s Wall, then cut off his escape with W Seismic Shove. If Skarner R Impale is still available, be careful not to move within its short range.
Skarner.fight: While Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is available, fight outside melee range and use Taliyah E Unraveled Earth to block his approach. Right after Skarner uses E Ixtal’s Impact, close the gap with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth or R Weaver’s Wall and catch him with W Seismic Shove. Don’t trade at a distance where you keep taking Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval’s empowered basic attacks.
Skarner.laning: Clear jungle camps quickly to scale, and look for counterganks where you can track Skarner’s path. Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth first in narrow approaches to check Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact.
Skarner.phase: In the late game, allowing even one engage is dangerous, so keep your distance from Skarner.
Skarner.teamfight: From the back line, place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on Skarner’s approach and use W Seismic Shove on his incoming path in advance to push him away from your allies. Use Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall to split the enemy team or block their escape route, and destroy it immediately if it blocks your team’s chase. In dragon and Baron fights, control the entrances with E Unraveled Earth and R Weaver’s Wall, but stay away from the pit’s edge so you don’t get dragged by Skarner R Impale.

Udyr.build: Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Udyr’s damage is mostly physical and Taliyah has low armor, so prioritize armor. To counter the healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle, fit Morellonomicon into your build after one core item.
Udyr.combo: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth first on Udyr’s approach or escape route, then use Taliyah W Seismic Shove to push him across it. Hit him with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley while he is stunned on the rock field. If Udyr is already escaping during a gank, aim Taliyah W Seismic Shove toward your allies.
Udyr.escape: The moment after you make Udyr use E Blazing Stampede is your window to pick him off. If he is awakened, immobilizing effects don’t work, so wait until it ends before using Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and W Seismic Shove. If Udyr E Blazing Stampede has already stunned you once, take advantage of the period when it can’t stun the same target again.
Udyr.fight: Poke from outside Udyr’s engage range, but save Taliyah W Seismic Shove for when he gets close. Look for a chance to attack when Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield is gone or right after he uses E Blazing Stampede. If Udyr E Blazing Stampede is awakened, wait for it to end, then lock him down with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and W Seismic Shove and hit him with Q Threaded Volley.
Udyr.laning: When Udyr is missing, don’t walk forward in lane; track his path with vision on key routes and jungle entrances. Look for counterganks where you can track his path.
Udyr.phase: Take opportunities aggressively in the mid game once you have accumulated ability power items, but keep your distance in the late game so Udyr can’t engage even once.
Udyr.teamfight: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on Udyr’s approach and push him away from your allies with Taliyah W Seismic Shove when he engages. If Udyr is tanking with defensive items and W Iron Mantle, don’t force your focus onto him; target the weaker enemies behind him first. In narrow objective terrain, use Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall to split the enemy team or block an entrance.
Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede can stun you with its first hit as he closes in, so place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on his approach in advance and hold Taliyah W Seismic Shove. While Udyr E Blazing Stampede is awakened, immobilizing effects don’t work, so push him away after the awakening ends. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on maximum health, so don’t stay close and fight for long.

Viego.build: Viego’s main damage is physical and Taliyah has low armor, so start with Cloth Armor, prioritize armor, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. If fights drag on because of the healing from Viego P Sovereign’s Domination and Q Blade of the Ruined King, fit Morellonomicon into your build after one core item.
Viego.combo: Place the rock field first with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth, then push Viego onto it with Taliyah W Seismic Shove. Hit him with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley while he is stunned crossing the rock field. If you use Taliyah W Seismic Shove first, you only push Viego without immobilizing him.
Viego.escape: Check whether Viego W Spectral Maw and R Heartbreaker, his ways to move, are available before engaging. In particular, the window before Viego R Heartbreaker comes back up is your chance: restrict his path with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and use Taliyah W Seismic Shove to push him and limit his chances to escape.
Viego.fight: Even if Viego W Spectral Maw is down, don’t go deep right away if Viego R Heartbreaker is still available. Before Viego R Heartbreaker comes back up, block his approach with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth, push him onto the rock field with Taliyah W Seismic Shove, then hit him with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley.
Viego.laning: Early on, focus on scaling by clearing camps quickly with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley instead of forcing fights, and look for counterganks when you can track Viego’s path. Don’t push your lane toward the black mist; move around that route. When ganking, place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on the escape route first and push the target onto it with Taliyah W Seismic Shove.
Viego.phase: In the late game, even allowing one engage is dangerous, so keep your distance and prioritize playing in a way that denies Viego kills.
Viego.teamfight: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on the approach to limit Viego’s access with W Spectral Maw, and push Viego away with Taliyah W Seismic Shove when he comes in. If an ally is taken down, push Viego away or lock him down so he can’t interact with the wraith there, and don’t keep fighting in that spot. Use Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall to split the enemy team or block a narrow objective entrance.
Viego.watch: Viego W Spectral Maw stuns for longer the more it is charged, so move to the side when you see him charging and interrupt it with Taliyah W Seismic Shove. If you see black mist on terrain, Viego may be camouflaged there, so avoid that route. When your health is low, fall back so you aren’t targeted by Viego R Heartbreaker.

Warwick.build: Warwick’s main damage is magic, so buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads. If fights drag on while Warwick sustains with P Eternal Hunger, Q Jaws of the Beast, and R Infinite Duress, fit Morellonomicon into your build after one core item.
Warwick.combo: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth first on Warwick’s approach or escape route. Then push him onto the rock field with Taliyah W Seismic Shove to stun him, and hit him with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley while he is stunned. If Warwick is already escaping, aim Taliyah W Seismic Shove so he is pushed toward your allies.
Warwick.escape: Don’t engage just because Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is down; look for a chance before Warwick R Infinite Duress comes back up. After Warwick E Primal Howl’s fear has gone off, block his path with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and cut off his escape direction with Taliyah W Seismic Shove. If you use Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall for movement, cast it before taking damage.
Warwick.fight: Save your burst while Warwick E Primal Howl is active and reposition after the fear goes off. Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on Warwick’s path in advance, then fire Taliyah Q Threaded Volley when he is stunned and has difficulty changing direction. Right after Warwick uses R Infinite Duress, he is held in place, so focus your counterattack with your allies.
Warwick.laning: Instead of forcing early ganks, look for counterganks where you can track Warwick’s jungle path. Recall if you remain below half health, since Warwick W Blood Hunt will track you.
Warwick.teamfight: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth in advance on a narrow path Warwick uses to engage, and push him away with Taliyah W Seismic Shove if he tries to reach your ranged damage dealers. Warwick R Infinite Duress can reach from far away when his movement speed is increased, so watch for it from across the pit during objective standoffs. Use Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall to split the enemy team or block an escape route, but remove the wall immediately if it blocks your allies’ chase.
Warwick.watch: When your health drops below half, Warwick W Blood Hunt reveals your position and increases his movement and attack speed, so give up farming and recall if your health is borderline. While Warwick E Primal Howl is active, it greatly reduces damage taken and can trigger fear early, so back off and fight after the fear goes off. Warwick R Infinite Duress can leap from far away to suppress you, so don’t treat the distance to an area without vision as safe.

XinZhao.build: Xin Zhao’s damage is mostly physical and Taliyah has low armor, so start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps. If healing from Xin Zhao P Determination is a problem, fit Morellonomicon into your build after completing one core item.
XinZhao.combo: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth first on Xin Zhao’s approach to stop his dash. When Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is down, push him onto the rock field with Taliyah W Seismic Shove to stun him, and hit him with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley while he is stunned.
XinZhao.escape: The moment after you make Xin Zhao use E Audacious Charge is your window to go in. Watch your distance so you don’t allow the third hit of Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, and catch him with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and W Seismic Shove.
XinZhao.fight: Right after Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is down is your chance to manage the distance and counterattack. If Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, don’t try to keep dealing damage from outside his spear range; attack after the immunity ends.
XinZhao.laning: Early on, don’t force fights because Taliyah uses a lot of mana and is fragile. Clear jungle camps quickly to scale, and look for counterganks where you can track Xin Zhao’s path.
XinZhao.phase: In the late game, allowing Xin Zhao to engage even once is dangerous, so keep your distance in the back line.
XinZhao.teamfight: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on the approach in advance and use Taliyah W Seismic Shove on the path Xin Zhao takes to engage with E Audacious Charge. Keep some distance from your allies so Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard’s knockback doesn’t split your formation. Use Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall to split the enemy team around Xin Zhao or block an escape route.
XinZhao.watch: Move to the side to dodge the second part of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning, the thrust. If it hits, the range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge increases, so watch for his engage. If you’ve been hit twice by Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike’s empowered basic attacks, get out of range before the third knocks you up.

Zac.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Zac’s damage is mostly magic, so prioritize magic resistance. To counter the healing from Zac P Cell Division, fit Morellonomicon into your build after one core item.
Zac.combo: Place the rock field first with Taliyah E Unraveled Earth, then push Zac onto it with Taliyah W Seismic Shove. Hit him with Taliyah Q Threaded Volley when he is stunned crossing the rock field. If you use Taliyah W Seismic Shove first, you only push Zac without immobilizing him.
Zac.escape: The moment after you make Zac use E Elastic Slingshot is your chance to go in. Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth, close the gap, then push Zac into it with Taliyah W Seismic Shove so he can’t get away.
Zac.fight: After you absorb Zac E Elastic Slingshot, create distance to help avoid damage from Zac W Unstable Matter, which he uses at close range. Right after Zac uses E, place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth, then approach and look for a chance to push him into it with Taliyah W Seismic Shove. During a fight, stepping on the blobs Zac drops can prevent his healing.
Zac.laning: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth in advance on approach routes where you may be able to see Zac charging E Elastic Slingshot.
Zac.phase: In the late game, allowing an engage even once is dangerous, so block Zac’s approach first and keep your distance.
Zac.teamfight: Place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on Zac’s path in, then push him away from your ranged damage dealers with Taliyah W Seismic Shove when he engages. Use Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall to split the enemy team or block an escape route in a fight where you’re stopping Zac’s engage.
Zac.watch: Zac E Elastic Slingshot has a visible charge and engages with a knock-up on landing. If you see him charging behind a wall, interrupt him with Taliyah W Seismic Shove, and place Taliyah E Unraveled Earth on his approach in advance to stun him during the dash.
